description: Using Multiecuscan diagnostic software, perform a complete engine fault diagnosis on a Fiat 500 1.3 MultiJet diesel. In simulation mode: (1) Navigate to the correct vehicle make, model, and engine control module, (2) Start a simulated connection, (3) Read the ECU identification information, (4) Read all Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), (5) Monitor at least 4 engine parameters (such as RPM, coolant temperature, battery voltage, throttle position), (6) Create a structured diagnostic report file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MultiecuscanTasks\engine_diagnostic_report.txt containing: ECU identification info, all DTCs found with descriptions (cross-reference with the DTC database in MultiecuscanData folder), parameter readings with normal range assessment, and a brief recommendation for each fault found. Use the DTC database CSV and diagnostic procedures guide provided in the MultiecuscanData folder for reference.
natural_language: Diagnose the engine of a Fiat 500 diesel using Multiecuscan simulation mode. Read ECU info, scan for error codes, monitor live parameters, and write a complete diagnostic report with DTC cross-references.
